name: crazy-goat/qrcode-ext
description: Native PHP extension backing crazy-goat/scanmephp — the C++ QR encoder behind NativeEncoder

suggest.crazy-goat/scanmephp: The PHP API this extension accelerates; on its own the extension exposes only NativeEncoderCore, which builds a CrazyGoat\ScanMePHP\Matrix and therefore needs the library loaded

configure-options.name: with-scanmeqr-clib
configure-options.description: Directory holding the C++ core as src/ and include/. Only meaningful when building from a ScanMePHP checkout; this package carries the sources and ignores it.
